scope: Independent content, primary-evidence, actual-image, formula/numeric/protocol/resource/metadata and source-button review of the two specified reports. This is not external peer review or experiment reproduction.

images.confirmation: Opened original pixels with view_image. Top separates normal ID scenes and red-box OOD examples across weather. Bottom shows RGB, closed-set prediction, anomaly GT and open-set GT; visible 32 raw labels are correctly distinguished from 19 evaluated ID classes. Red boxes mark illustrative locations.

Opened original pixels with view_image. Three RGB/prelabel/refined-GT columns show boundary and vegetation corrections and manually assigned unknown obstacles. Appendix I caption confirms rows ID, OOD validation and OOD test. Report does not infer absence of annotation bias.

Opened original pixels with view_image. Visible 2 Hz hypothesis propagation and 10 Hz diffusion, left-bottom likelihood-style schematic, right-side recurrent left/right passing hypotheses. Report correctly distinguishes the actual score-exponential update and weighted embedding from the schematic action labels.

Opened original pixels with view_image. Frames t=1–3, 4–6 and 7–10; initial weights 0.25 each; final STOP 0.22, DECELERATE 0.78, GO_STRAIGHT/LANE_CHANGE 0.00. Last texts mention red light, cyclist and left turn. Report correctly treats bars as maneuver marginal rather than proof of executed control or rule compliance.

DriveOSS: All quoted Table 3–7 numbers and units match the fixed paper; four splits total 52 sequences and 12,661 LiDAR frames, with 75,966=6×12,661 images.
Equations S4–S6 preserve validation-calibrated 95% OOD TPR, fixed test threshold, 19-ID-class mean and separately reported outlier IoU; test-curve FPR95 is explicitly distinguished.
External ID training datasets, differing training schedules and one-front-camera fusion protocol are disclosed.

Pinned public code confirms inclusive 2.5–50 m range and whole-frame anomaly-metric gate for fewer than 5 valid OOD points. Segmentation path has no such frame gate. The report does not assert that unpublished per-table commands necessarily used every default.
STU/NDP/LIDO comparisons are supported by their own primary texts and preserve protocol and auxiliary-OOD supervision differences.

Live GitHub README confirms code repository and data/weights coming soon. Captured full tree contains no LIDO-specific directory or checkpoint files. README recipe discrepancy is not recast as evidence that published test scoring was wrong.
DriveMind: Quoted Table 1–8 numbers, learning rates, batch sizes, DDPM steps and waypoint count match the fixed paper. Efficiency and signalized-intersection SR regressions remain adjacent to positive results.
Equations 8–10 and 12, score range, resampling reset and frozen-VLM belief caching match the source; no calibrated-posterior or directly executed discrete-action claim is introduced.
K versus initial maneuver coverage, four-category diversity saturation, scoring classification versus closed-loop evidence and NAVSIM versus interactive Bench2Drive are kept distinct.
Runtime correctly separates isolated component P95 from system means and notes stale belief and missing shared-GPU tail/driving-quality comparisons as evidence gaps.
Fixed PDF first page confirms Haicheng Liao fifth and Yinhai Wang sixth. Official conference author order/spelling, Atom Haichen spelling and headline baseline difference are disclosed.
NeurIPS official Poster destination supports accepted status, without claiming proceedings publication. Live GitHub main listing contains only .gitignore and README; release claims remain bounded.
